question: Under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin) in Himachal Pradesh, 19,578 houses have been sanctioned in Himachal Pradesh and _________ houses have been completed as of November 9, 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**14906 houses**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **14,906 houses** have been completed under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin) in Himachal Pradesh as of November 9, 2023.
 
• The scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the rural population by the year 2022.
 
• Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the beneficiaries for the construction of houses.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's effort to achieve "Housing for All" by 2022.
 
• The scheme has specific criteria for the selection of beneficiaries, ensuring that the most deserving families receive aid.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)** was launched on November 20, 2016, to provide affordable housing to the rural poor.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• It aims to construct 2.95 crore houses with all basic amenities by 2022.
 
• The financial assistance provided under the scheme is Rs. 1.20 lakh per unit in plains and Rs. 1.30 lakh per unit in hilly states, difficult areas, and Integrated Action Plan (IAP) districts.
 
• The houses built under this scheme are designed to be disaster-resilient and environmentally sustainable.
 
• The beneficiaries are selected based on the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data.
